text: For the director of music. A psalm of David. May the Lord answer you when you are in distress; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
and grant you support from Zion.
and accept your burnt offerings. Selah
and make all your plans succeed.
and will lift up our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord grant all your requests.
he answers him from his holy heaven with the saving power of his right hand.
but we trust in the name of the Lord our God.
but we rise up and stand firm.
